title: Generation-cutoff precedence change causing customer eval drift across Hosted/Dedicated/Private
creator: Miguel Torres
description: Multiple customers reported sudden quality regressions in their eval suites and production prompts after a serving runtime change that altered generation cutoff precedence. The change affected how post-processing stop conditions (customer stop sequences + runtime-level cutoff heuristics) are composed, leading to over-generation for some prompt shapes and premature truncation for others. Reports span Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments; highest-severity customer is a fintech partner with automated KYC flows. This ticket tracks investigation, root-cause, mitigation, and rollout of a tested fix plus guardrails to prevent recurrence.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use model variant redwood/ggml-v3 (or compatible Llama-derived weights) with default sampling profile introduced in runtime-1.19

2) Send customer prompt with embedded metadata and custom stop_sequence ['

### END'] via Hosted API endpoint with streaming enabled

3) Observe that generated text either continues past the explicit stop_sequence (over-generation) or terminates early when a runtime-level cutoff heuristic matches a token subsequence in the prompt prefix (premature truncation), depending on request batching and KV cache reuse state
4) Reproduce in Dedicated by toggling pool config 'generation_cutoff_precedence' between 'runtime-first' and 'request-first' to observe behaviour differences
5) In Private (VPC) deployment, confirm the regression when runtime agents are upgraded to the 1.19 binary and the local config inherits global defaults without explicit override
root_cause: A change in runtime-1.19 composition logic altered the precedence between request-specified termination criteria and internal generation-cutoff heuristics used for latency SLOs. The new logic applied internal heuristics before honoring request stop sequences in certain batched/streamed code paths and failed to consider per-tenant prompt wrappers used by some customers.
mitigation_actions: Hotfix: revert precedence to 'request-first' for termination checks in streaming and batch execution paths (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3124)
Feature toggle: add 'generation_cutoff_precedence' config with allowed values [request-first, runtime-first] for Dedicated/Private customers
Short-term: rollback runtime-1.19 rollout on Hosted for affected regions while customers validate
Customer communications: notify impacted accounts with reproducible examples and temporary mitigations (support tickets #INC-5482, #INC-5491)
Postmortem: schedule root-cause doc and QA checklist before re-release
qa_checks: Add unit tests asserting stop-sequence wins when present (streaming and batch code paths)
Regression tests: run affected customers' eval suites against patched runtime in staging and Dedicated canary pool
Load tests: ensure change does not regress latency SLOs under representative batching
Integration tests: validate opt-in feature toggle behavior in Private deployments
